rows.title: The Exchange has sought clarification from Cello World Ltd on October 07, 2026, with reference to Movement in Volume. The reply is awaited.
Spurt in Volume
rows.summary: Significant increase in volume has been observed in Cello World Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. Cello World Limited has submitted their response.
